subject: Missed discovery — Silverline follow-up: quick recon & slot choice
messages:
From: Avery Johnson <avery_johnson@redwoodinference.com>
To: Ethan Morris <ethan.morris@silverline.io>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-12-05T09:08:00-08:00
Subject: Missed discovery — Silverline follow-up: quick recon & slot choice

Hi Ethan —

Sorry we missed you on the call this morning. Hope everything is okay on your end. We had Marissa and Ben on the line; we kept the session short and gathered a few items that will help us tailor the technical deep dive if you still want one. Quick recap:

- You were exploring low-latency inference for our clinical summarization pipeline (50–200 tokens per request).
- Main constraints: PCI/SOC-2 processes around PHI handling, regional isolation (US-only), and predictable 99th %-ile latency under 200ms.
- Primary stakeholders: you (ML lead), procurement for contracts, and infra (ops).

Next steps — two options depending on your preference:
1) Quick technical deep dive (30m) with our serving engineer to scope latency/cost tradeoffs.
2) Follow-on procurement sync if you want to prioritize contract terms first.

If option 1, please pick one of the two firm slots we can hold for you today/tomorrow and confirm by EOD so we won't open the calendar:
- 2026-12-05 2:00–2:30 PM PT
- 2026-12-06 9:00–9:30 AM PT

I’ve attached a short one-page recap and an .ics with both slots (Attachment: silverline-demo-2x-slots.ics / recap_20261205.pdf). If neither works, tell me two windows and I’ll escalate to reserve an engineer.

Thanks — hope the day smooths out.

Best,
Avery Johnson
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
avery_johnson@redwoodinference.com | (415) 555-0131

(Attachment: recap_20261205.pdf, silverline-demo-2x-slots.ics)

From: Ethan Morris <ethan.morris@silverline.io>
To: Avery Johnson <avery_johnson@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: procurement@silverline.io
Date: 2026-12-05T10:22:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Missed discovery — Silverline follow-up: quick recon & slot choice

Hi Avery —

Apologies — I had an urgent incident in the production environment and had to step out. Really appreciate you and the team for keeping the call. The issues are under control now.

We definitely want option 1 (technical deep dive). The 2:00 PM slot today is tight for our infra lead. 9:00 AM tomorrow works for me, but I need to check with our SRE (Priya) — she’s on call this week.

Can you hold the 9:00 AM slot for one hour while I confirm with Priya? If she can’t make it, we’ll still join with me + procurement and then schedule a follow-up technical-only session.

Thanks for the quick recap — that helped.

— Ethan
Ethan Morris
Head of ML Engineering | Silverline Health
ethan.morris@silverline.io | (617) 555-0148

Thanks Ethan — appreciate the quick reply.

We’ll tentatively hold the 9:00 AM PT slot for 30 minutes and mark it as "needs confirmation". If Priya can confirm, we’ll send the deep-dive invite with Ben (serving runtime lead) and Marissa (solutions engineer).

If Priya cannot make it, two fallback options that still get you an actionable session:
- Bingo: 15-min pre-warm with me + Marissa to align requirements, then schedule a 45-min engineering deep dive with Ben.
- Or: keep the 30-min deep dive and have Priya join asynchronously (we’ll record + share notes).

Can you confirm by 3:00 PM PT today? That keeps Ben’s schedule manageable — he’s booked late week. If we don’t hear back, we’ll release the slot at 3:15 PM PT.

I’ve attached a one-pager we’ll cover in the deep dive (recap_20261205.pdf) and added a calendar invite with both times so you can pick directly (silverline-demo-2x-slots.ics).

Thanks —
Avery
